index.title: AI-gile: kulupu ilo pali sina lon supa wan
index.description: AI-gile li supa kanban pi kulupu pali ilo. ona li pali lon tenpo lape sina; sina jo e kulupu lili pi pali sina: o wile sona, o lukin, o kama pona.
hero.h1.html: kulupu ilo pali sina lon supa wan.
hero.alphaTitle: ni li sin li pini ala: sina lukin la pona a!
hero.lede: ona li pali lon tenpo lape sina. tenpo suno la sina jo e kulupu lili: toki lili, pali lili pi lukin sina, kiwen kule pi loje laso tu. o luka, o kama pona, o tawa moku telo sina.
hero.secondary: pali pona, taso kulupu li wile ala moku telo lon tenpo toki. (taso ona li toki lon tenpo ni.)
pitch.h2: AI-gile lon nimi mute anu lili
pitch.lede: o alasa e suli, nimi wan tawa nimi 144. suli ale li jo e toki ona. o tawa e ilo sike anu o luka e nena.
count.line.html.one: lipu {n} li lon supa tenpo ni
count.line.html.other: lipu {n} li lon supa tenpo ni
f.pile.html: tawa sina li lawa e ale pi wile sina lon pali ale: toki, pali lukin, pali pi jan taso. lipu pini li toki e ni: seme li kama, tenpo ni li suli seme.
f.sleep.h: kulupu li pali lon tenpo lape sina
f.sleep.p: pali ale li jo e jan lawa e kulupu pi ilo pali AI. o toki lon lipu la kulupu li kama lape ala, li pali, li pana tawa sina kepeken nasin pi jan lape ala.
f.tester.h: jan lukin AI li lukin pini
f.tester.p: pali li tawa sina ala la jan lukin li kepeken nasin lon ilo sama li pana e sitelen. o lukin e ale pona, o kama pona kepeken luka wan.
f.proof.p: pana ale li pana e ante: lipu, ante, sitelen. sina wile ala open e ilo ale tawa sona.
f.chat.h: o toki tawa jan lawa sina
f.chat.p: ni li sama Discord: sitelen wan tawa pali wan, kiwen kule pi loje laso lon ni: sina wile. o toki e wile sina tawa jan lawa; ona li pali e lipu e nasin, kepeken nena ✅ o open.
f.tidy.p: lipu sama li kama wan, nimi nasa li pona, lukin pi mani ilo li awen lili e ilo pali. ante lili, toki lili.
f.private.li1: supa li pali lon ilo sina, li toki tawa sina taso.
f.private.li2: toki len pi jan tawa jan li len pi open ala.
f.private.li3: nimi jan ala, jan lukin ala, kili ala.
f.lang.p: toki mute a: toki 120 anu mute, tan toki Netelan e toki Kimli e toki Nijon tawa toki pi jan pi tawa telo, toki Yoda, toki Klingon, kepeken nena wan tawa toki Inli pi nimi pi jan sona.
f.service.h: tan sona lili tawa pali lon tawa jan
f.service.p: jan li kepeken e ijo sina tan AI lon tenpo ni anu seme? o sitelen e ni: ona li pali tawa jan. supa li pona e awen sina: lukin pi pali lon, lipu pi pona pali tawa jan ale, pakala suli en sona pakala pini, ante li wile e o tawa, awen sin li lukin lon tenpo suno ale. lipu sona li pana e nasin ale lon tenpo pali sina.
msgr.h2: AI-gile Messenger: kulupu sina li lon poki len sina
msgr.p1: o toki tawa kulupu AI sina. sina open ala e lipu pali. o toki tawa jan lawa pali sina en jan pona sina, o lukin e nasin alasa pi lipu pali, o pana e toki tawa ona. ale li lon ilo toki sina.
msgr.p2: o lukin e sitelen QR lon lipu pali sina la ona li kama wan. tenpo nanpa wan? toki musi pona li pana e sona tawa sina.
msgr.when: Android li kama nanpa wan. sin la ilo toki ale en iPhone li ken kepeken lipu linluwi.
msgr.b1: pona pi nasin pimeja li pini. sina wile ala wile e nasin alasa?
msgr.b3: 1. o open e nasin ilo. 2. o anu e pimeja. ona li pona ala pona?
tl.aria: linja tenpo tan toki nanpa wan tawa nasin kama
tl.h2: tan toki nanpa wan tawa ni li kama
tl.lede: tenpo lon, lon tenpo pi ma sina. tenpo kama la ni li pali taso; tenpo ala li pana.
join.lede: jan nasa wan pi linja sinpin en ilo pali mute pi pilin pona li pali e AI-gile. jan ni li jo e AuDHD, li utala e pilin ike lawa. tenpo ni la AI-gile li len, lon open lili tawa jan pona. tenpo open la sina wile lukin ala wile?
join.small: mi toki tawa sina kepeken lipu toki, ala ante

footer.thanks: toki kalama li tan ChilledChat. pona!

form.keep: mi kepeken ni tawa toki sin tawa sina taso, la mi weka e ona. jan lukin ala, kili ala.

licence.lede: sina kepeken AI-gile lon pali sina anu seme? o toki e sina e pali sina. ni li pona la lipu li mani ala.

licence.thanks: pona a! mi toki tawa sina kepeken lipu toki.

status.intro: AI-gile li pali ala pali lon tenpo ni? tenpo lili 5 ale la lipu ni li lukin e lipu linluwi, e pana supa, e toki kalama, e kama jo.

privacy.title: AI-gile: mi awen e seme
privacy.lede: lili la: ijo pi sina pana taso, li tenpo suli ala.
privacy.only: ijo pi sina pana taso: sitelen sina lon lipu wile, sama nimi lipu toki sina. ijo ante pi sina li lon ala.
privacy.sealed: mi len e ona la ilo suli mi li ken ala lukin e ona: ni li kama lon ilo lukin sina, lon tenpo pi tawa ona ala (lon ilo lukin pi tenpo pini la, lon tenpo kama ona). supa mi taso li ken open e ona.
privacy.server: ona li kama lon supa mi la, mi weka e ona tan ilo suli. tenpo suno 30 la ijo ale lon ilo suli li weka.
privacy.board: mi awen e ona lon supa mi lon tenpo pi toki sin mi tawa sina taso. ni la mi weka e ona lon supa kin.
privacy.none: jan lukin ala, kili ala, nanpa lukin ala.
privacy.local: toki sina en kule walo anu pimeja sina li awen lon ilo lukin sina. ona li tawa mi ala.
privacy.ask: sina wile ala wile e weka lon tenpo lili? o toki sin tawa lipu toki mi, o toki e wile ni.
